title: Voltage across R1
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage across R1 using voltage division, yielding 3.75 V.

title: Voltage across R2
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage across R2 using voltage division, yielding 11.25 V.

title: Parallel equivalent resistance
description: Important: Correctly calculates the equivalent resistance for R1||Rv (6 kΩ) and R2||Rv (9 kΩ).

title: Voltmeter reading at C
description: Essential: Correctly applies voltage division with the parallel equivalent to find the voltmeter reading when S is at C (15/7 V).

title: Voltmeter reading at D
description: Essential: Correctly applies voltage division with the parallel equivalent to find the voltmeter reading when S is at D (45/7 V).

title: Voltage division reasoning
description: Important: Applies the voltage divider formula correctly for series combinations in all parts.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent use of kΩ and V throughout calculations.

title: Ignoring voltmeter loading
description: Pitfall: For parts (2), incorrectly uses the original resistor values without accounting for the parallel voltmeter resistance.
